purpose: Secondary predeclared information-load sensitivity after correcting pickup TTL, failed-operation telemetry, stock ownership and duplicated service plans. It cannot replace or conceal the original 24-needs/192-noise experiment.
stages: Freeze fresh exact source bytes and complete mechanism verification before paid comparisons.
Run the corrected original profile on its original first seed. Retain the entire physical funnel and negative result, if any.
Run free B5 and B8 on information-load-2026-01 before buying semantic interpretation. Inspect whether physical capacity, confirmation workers or communication dominate the result.
Only proceed with paid perception if the free funnel leaves a causally plausible information-processing bottleneck. Record the decision before running B6.
Run every declared primary seed and sensitivity once the profile is admitted. Preserve failures, unknown provider costs, censoring and source invalidation. No favorable model retry selection.
guardrails: All arms receive identical public bytes and formal observations; all use the same stock, map, vehicle assignment, explicit pickup TTL, field verification and owner review.
Explicit requests, lineage deduplication, strict routine commentary and received progress reconciliation are free for all references. No baseline is forced to reread obvious structured information.
Each controller is isolated from evaluator truth, gold labels, future events and undelivered messages.

Primary endpoint: restricted mean time until sufficient physical service at the fixed 3h horizon, including unserved needs. First useful service and matched served-only times are secondary, not replacements.
Check native deficits, delivered quantity, all-need coverage, overprovisioning, distance, fuel, duplicate execution, ledger invariants, model failures and charged costs.

Finite human reading parameters and template proportions are uncalibrated modeling assumptions. Faster interpretation in this family does not establish real-world lives saved or superiority over every inexpensive automatic filter.
No claim of 100 concurrent physical problems per minute or guaranteed x1000 complete model pipeline; engine, UI, provider and physical service are distinct measurements.
Gemma is the measured model. Gemini, GCP deployment, human comprehension and independent disaster validation remain separate future gates.
